name: @r4-adapters/identity-verification
description: R4-J4 SEC-OTP channel identity verification (outside R4 Core). SEC-S1: pure classifier of inbound text while a verification is pending. SEC-S2: transient state in its own schema identity_verification (expectations, sealed responses, leases and fencing, expiry and purge) and the AES-256-GCM SecretBox. SEC-S3: the InboundInspector v1 implementation (redaction and sealed capture inside the locked inbound transaction) and the durable component mode (full / protect_only). No channel or provider names; no network.
